title: The online manual and navigation
steps: Open User Manual near the bottom of the sidebar. Its 13 chapters match this PDF.
Use the chapter rail or popular-topic cards to jump to an area.
Press / in the online manual to focus search. In this PDF use your reader's Find command.

title: Dark theme
steps: Select Dark Theme in the sidebar to use the dark palette.
Select Light Theme to return. The preference is remembered by this browser.

title: Navigation on a phone
steps: Tap the menu button in the top bar to open navigation.
Choose an area, tap outside the panel, or press Esc to close it.
Long lists and forms continue vertically; use their own filters and actions.

title: Preview role permissions
steps: Administrators can expand Preview access in the sidebar and select Editor or Reviewer.
Apply changes the menus and effective permissions. Return to Administrator ends the preview.
Preview actions affect application data. Use a separate sample environment when practicing.

title: Start the day on the Dashboard
steps: Scan the summary cards for your workload, the booking pipeline, and items needing review.
Work through My Work, then review upcoming engagements and incomplete details.
Open the linked record to make the change, then return to the Dashboard.

title: Read and filter the booking board
steps: Search requests and narrow by owner, stage, or next action.
Open a card to review the request and its next step.
The default view includes active inquiries and bookings from this month. Other stages remain available in the filter.

title: Review an inquiry
steps: Review the preferred and alternate dates, priority, owner, and next action.
Use Activity, Correspondence, and Tasks to switch the working panel.
Change stage as the request develops; a decline needs a reason and can be reopened.

title: Capture the request and date options
steps: Enter the request title and summary. Choose the organization and primary contact when known.
Record preferred dates, alternate dates, event type, and location.
Choose an owner, priority, source, next action, and due date, then save.

title: Give the inquiry a next action
steps: Keep the next action concrete, such as sending date options or requesting room details.
Set a due date so the pipeline and Dashboard can highlight it.
Use Source Detail for a referral, mailbox, form, or campaign reference.

title: Convert a qualified inquiry
steps: Review the proposed engagement and any schedule conflicts.
Choose the open inquiry tasks to move; clearing every box moves none.
Carry an unresolved next action forward as a task, or resolve it with a reason.
Acknowledge any availability warnings before confirming the conversion.

title: Write inquiry correspondence
steps: Choose Initial response, Request details, Date options, or Proposal follow-up.
Verify the primary contact, then edit the subject and plain-text message.
Queue the message when ready; its signed inquiry marker keeps replies connected.
note: The screenshot preview has mail delivery disabled. The form is shown without sending a message.

title: Find an engagement
steps: Search the complete list, then use lifecycle and current/archive filters.
Sort by organization, date, confirmation, or lifecycle.
Open the event title or View action. Financial closeout is a separate status from planning confirmation.

title: Use the engagement workspace
steps: Read the event summary and right-side readiness and next-action information.
Switch among Activity, Correspondence, Tasks, Presentations, Contacts, Logistics, and Financials.
Use the nearby routing-marker copy control when continuing a conversation in another email application.

title: Edit event details and schedule
steps: Choose an active organization and enter the event title and description.
Set valid start and end dates. Choose Other and describe the type when presets do not fit.
Assign a Caller for the initial checklist; later Caller changes do not transfer existing tasks.

title: Assign event-specific contact roles
steps: Open Contacts to see the people assigned to this event and their roles.
In Edit Engagement, add existing contacts or create new people. Assign Primary host, On-site contact, Billing, Travel, and Materials as applicable.
These roles are separate from a contact's organization affiliations.

title: Presentation details and audience resources
steps: Open Presentations and review each speaker, title, schedule, duration, and attendance.
Use Copy Text, Copy MD, or View PDF for a presentation brief.
View saved speaker notes, copy a QR image, download PNG/SVG, or open the QR Codes PDF.

title: Edit a presentation and speaker notes
steps: Choose a saved speaker and enter topic, date, time, duration, and expected attendance.
Choose PDF or Replace PDF to attach public speaker notes up to 100 MB. Save to upload it.
Record actual attendance after the event. Zero is valid when nobody attended.
The nearby Save Changes button saves the whole engagement form.

title: Review event logistics
steps: Open Logistics to review the event address, materials, travel, compensation, and lodging.
Planning estimates describe arrangements; actual received amounts belong in Financial Closeout.
Keep the physical event location accurate for the map and presentation exports.

title: Lifecycle and rescheduling
steps: Use Active, Postponed, Canceled, or Completed to describe the operational state.
Keep Work in Progress, Under Review, or Confirmed as the separate planning confidence.
Provide a cancellation reason. When rescheduling, link the replacement event from the same organization.

title: Review presentation QR activity
steps: Select a date range and review the visits and distribution charts.
A presentation code measures its own activity; the speaker view combines that speaker's presentations.
Open a single link to change its destination or enable/disable it. Administrators reset all statistics for a presentation from that presentation's card.
note: The chart uses fictional, seeded visit counts to illustrate the report.

title: Review financial closeout
steps: Open Financials to see whether a report is open, a draft, or final.
Use Financial Closeout to enter giving/income, lodging, and travel actually received.
A draft does not enter finalized organization financial history.

title: Draft and finalize received amounts
steps: Leave unknown draft amounts blank; enter zero only when nothing was received.
Resolve every task due on or before the last active presentation by marking it Completed. Canceled tasks still hold closeout.
Check the final-amount confirmation, then Finalize and close event when prerequisites are satisfied.
For a final report, use correction to update amounts while retaining the original close date.

title: Manage the email template library
steps: Open Email Templates under Work in the sidebar, or Manage Email Templates in an engagement email.
Search by name or subject. Select + New Email Template, a template name, or its Edit action.
Archive removes a template from new messages. Open Archived and choose Restore to use it again.
Only administrators can permanently delete an archived template after confirming access. Sent messages and history remain unchanged.
note: Fictional records from the isolated template preview; no email was queued during capture.

title: Add or edit reusable email text
steps: Enter a clear template name, a subject, and the starting plain-text message.
Use event fields such as {{event_name}} in the text. The engagement routing marker is added automatically when composing.
Existing templates can be edited too. Save Changes updates the template for future selections, leaving sent messages intact.
If another session changed the template, preserve your edits, reload, and review the current version before saving.
note: Fictional records from the isolated template preview; no email was queued during capture.

title: Personalize fields and suggest recipients
steps: Expand Personalize with event fields. Place the cursor in the subject or message, then select a field button.
Presentation schedule is available in the message only. Speaker names inserts text; it does not select recipients.
Choose suggested event contact roles. Leave all clear to choose contacts when composing. Lower Display order numbers appear first.
Save the template. Open an engagement email, choose it, and review the filled text and recipients before queuing.
note: Fictional records from the isolated template preview; no email was queued during capture.

title: Browse organizations
steps: Search by organization details or active contact information.
Review location, active contacts, last giving, and lifetime giving.
Use Active/Archived, sorting, and Records per page to manage a longer directory.

title: Review relationship history
steps: Use Activity for organization-level Chron.
Switch to Contacts, Engagements, Tasks, or Financials for related information.
Use Edit Organization to maintain details and add or move contacts.

title: Read organization financial history
steps: Open Financials for finalized giving, lodging, travel, and event reports.
Draft closeout amounts do not affect these totals.
Open an event report for the underlying figures and correction history.

title: Organization identity and addresses
steps: Only the organization name is required. Add affiliation, distinctives, contact channels, and notes when known.
Choose country before state or province. US and Canadian regions use dropdowns; other countries accept typed regions.
Use Same as Physical Address when mailing details match.

title: Browse contacts
steps: Search by person or organization.
Sort by last name or organization and adjust Records per page.
Open a contact to review their own history and all affiliations.

title: Read a contact record
steps: Check name, role, email, phone, photo, and organization links.
Keep person-specific conversations in this contact's Chron.
Create follow-up work here to retain the relationship context.

title: Maintain affiliations and a photo
steps: Enter names and contact channels; an organization is optional.
Set the primary organization role and add additional organization affiliations with their own roles.
Use Other with Describe Other Role for a custom title.
Upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP photo up to 5 MB and save. Create Organization preserves the contact draft.

title: Find a saved speaker
steps: Search by name, email, or phone; use Name to reverse alphabetical order.
Open the speaker or choose New Speaker to create a profile.
Speaker profiles are permanent; update an existing profile instead of duplicating it.

title: Speaker profile and resources
steps: Review the reusable speaker identity, biography, and audience links.
Open Statistics to review activity across the speaker's presentations.
Edit the profile to maintain shared details. The written biography and Bio URL serve different purposes.

title: Edit standard and custom resource links
steps: Add full web addresses for audience resources.
Choose Add Custom Link, provide its name and URL, and save the speaker.
New links receive separate codes on existing and future presentations.
Removing or renaming a profile link preserves already-published codes. Manage an individual code in Statistics.

title: Work the queue
steps: Choose Mine, Everyone, or Unassigned.
Use status, due-date, priority, search, and related-record controls to focus the list.
Use row actions to assign, start, complete, reopen, or edit work.
Overdue and due-today highlights draw attention; the sidebar badge counts your active assigned tasks.

title: Edit a task
steps: Write a concrete title and notes.
Search at least three characters and select the intended related record, or use general work.
Set assignee, due date, priority, and status. Waiting work should name the person or decision it needs.
Save task to persist the change.

title: Duplicate a task to another event
steps: Choose Duplicate to Another Event from the task editor.
Search events and select a destination different from the source event.
Review copied title and notes, ownership, due date, priority, and status before saving.
The original task remains unchanged.

title: Manage reusable event checklists
steps: Open Standard Event Tasks from the Work Queue.
Create or edit the content, priority, display order, and offset from event start or end.
Changes affect generation; existing task content is independently editable.
The required financial reminder is fixed at one week after event end.

title: Define a standard event task
steps: Enter the reusable title and notes.
Choose the date anchor and number of days before or after it.
Set priority and display order, then save.
Add Missing Checklist Tasks on an active engagement creates absent items assigned to the person performing that action.

title: Add a Chron entry
steps: Use Add Chron Log Entry to record a decision without opening the complete edit form.
Include the context, outcome, and agreed next step.
Save the entry; its author and time appear in reverse chronological history.

title: Choose event recipients and a template
steps: Choose an active template or Custom message. Review event fields after they are filled.
Select event contacts, then use Speaker or an individual speaker card to include an assigned speaker. Speakers are unchecked by default.
Only speakers assigned to active presentations with valid email addresses can receive mail. Speaker-only messages are allowed.
Each unique address receives one separate email. Changing templates preserves selected speakers. Review the message and brief before Queue Email.
note: This example selects Casey Speaker explicitly. No email was queued during capture.

title: Review the message and brief
steps: Edit the plain-text message for the event.
Expand Preview Event Brief to inspect the optional share-safe information before including it.
The event marker is maintained for routing. A sent checklist email does not complete its related task automatically.

title: Review copied inbound email
steps: Open Inbox in the sidebar. Use Needs review, Pending, Processing, Failed, Processed, Rejected, or All to choose a queue.
Search by subject, sender, or message content. Change Order or use the queue pages when needed. Needs review starts oldest first.
On a wide screen, the message list is on the left, the reader is in the middle, and the filing panel is on the right.
Select a message to read it. Search messages stays visible at a consistent vertical position. On a phone, use Back to messages to return to the queue.

title: Read a message and choose its Chron Logs
steps: Read the sender, subject, and message. Expand Message details for recipients, sent time, and attachment names; open Routing details for matching reasons.
Review the reason in the right-hand filing panel. Choose the intended Contact, Organization, or Inquiry suggestions when available. Scroll down to search and select an active Engagement.
Check the selected Chron log count, then choose Save to Chron logs. Processed messages show Message status and Saved to Chron so you can review their destinations.

Find matches again checks routing after record corrections. Other actions contains Reject message. Administrators can expand Manage retained email below the reader to purge the retained source after confirmation.

title: Locate engagements
steps: Filter the date window, lifecycle, and confirmation state.
Select a pin for event context; use Fit visible pins after filtering.
Use the list views to find missing addresses, pending lookups, or unlocated records, then Edit location.

title: Confirm an event pin
steps: Check the written event address before changing a pin.
Zoom and click the map, drag the pin, or enter latitude and longitude.
Check the venue confirmation, then Save confirmed pin. Use automatic lookup clears an override.
A later address change requires checking the pin again.

title: Browse the month calendar
steps: Use Previous, Next, or Today to navigate months.
Choose Events, My Tasks, All Tasks, Birthdays, or Everything.
Tasks need an active status and a due date to appear.
Click an event, task, or birthday to open its record. The rose Today cell is separate from event/task colors.

title: Private calendar subscriptions
steps: Name each device or service, and choose Events, Presentations, My Active Work, All Active Work, and/or Birthdays (from Contacts).
Create the link, copy its private URL immediately, and add it in the calendar application as a subscribed calendar.
Treat the URL as an access credential for its selected content, including task information when work is selected.
Revoke one device link when no longer needed; purge revoked records separately.

title: Profile and daily work digest
steps: Maintain name, email, phone, and optional picture.
Verify an email change to re-enable recovery and the digest.
Choose digest time and days, or turn the digest off.
Resending verification preserves the current profile draft and chosen photo.

title: Manage account security
steps: Enroll or replace the authenticator as needed. Administrators must use 2FA.
Change your password with the current password and required factor.
Generate fresh recovery codes when needed; save them securely because each works once.
Administrator resets and password changes can invalidate other sessions.

title: Start authenticator replacement
steps: Confirm your password and, when replacing an enrolled factor, your current authentication code.
Scan the enrollment QR code in an authenticator or enter its setup key.
Enter the generated six-digit code to verify enrollment, then store the recovery codes.
note: Only the initial confirmation screen is illustrated. Enrollment secrets and recovery codes are intentionally absent.

title: Connect MOED and Mattermost
steps: When configured, generate a one-time linking code here and run /moed connect CODE in Mattermost.
Use /moed today, /moed tasks, and event search/show for private context.
Editors and administrators may link channels and review task, Chron, and email actions.
Unlink an account here to revoke its Mattermost command access.
note: The disposable preview is not connected to Mattermost. The chapter explains the configured plugin workflow; this screen shows its setup prerequisite.

title: Review users and access state
steps: Review role, activation, verified email, 2FA, and activity.
Invite a user with their own email and role. The invitation is valid for seven days.
Unlock sensitive actions with your administrator password and a fresh factor before changing another account.

title: Invite a new user
steps: Confirm administrator access, then choose a unique username, email address, and role.
Review the recipient and access level before sending the invitation.
The recipient creates their own password through the activation link. Configure digest preferences from the user editor afterward.
note: This form is shown without submitting an invitation.

title: Confirm administrator access
steps: Enter your administrator password and a fresh authenticator or recovery code.
Continue to the sensitive action and review the target.
Elevation lasts five minutes; some lifecycle operations consume it immediately.

title: Inspect the audit trail
steps: Filter by category, search text, date range, and exact IP address.
Review actor, action, affected record, and local/UTC timestamps.
Individual audit records cannot be edited or removed through ordinary record controls.

title: Preview audit retention
steps: Open the retention panel and choose the number of days to keep.
Preview the UTC cutoff and affected count before pruning.
Fresh administrator confirmation, the exact PRUNE phrase, and the final in-app confirmation are required.

title: Export an encrypted database backup
steps: Review estimated size against the 512 MB browser export limit.
Provide your administrator password and fresh factor. Choose and confirm a unique backup password of at least 16 characters.
Encrypt and Download Backup creates a .dnrbackup snapshot. Keep its password and the separate 2FA encryption key securely available.
Restoration is a deployment-host procedure described in the repository runbook.

title: Review operational health
steps: Inspect task backlog, geocoding queues, mail review/failures, and authentication failures.
Check migration readiness and the latest recorded encrypted backup.
Follow the linked application view for work you can resolve; give deployment faults to the operator.

title: Find help quickly
steps: Search the online manual for a term such as financial closeout.
Use Clear to return to all chapters.
In this PDF use the contents, bookmarks, related-topic links, topic finder, or your reader's text search.

title: Copy or export a presentation brief
steps: In Presentations, expand Export Presentation at the bottom of the card.
Copy Text produces plain text; Copy MD produces Markdown.
View PDF opens the branded presentation brief. View QR Codes PDF opens the landscape resource sheet for viewing, saving, or printing.

title: Change an existing QR destination
steps: Review the specific code and its activity.
Edit Destination and save to redirect an already-published resource code without changing its image.
Clear Link enabled and save to stop that code from opening its destination.
For speaker notes, replace the PDF on the presentation; its destination is managed automatically.

title: Reset one presentation's statistics
steps: Administrators open Reset Presentation Statistics on the presentation card.
Confirm the exact presentation and obtain fresh administrator access.
Reset Statistics to Zero permanently clears all dates and all its links, including disabled links and previous speakers.
Codes, destinations, notes, and other presentations stay intact; new visits start at zero.
note: The reset review screen is illustrated; no statistics were deleted.

title: Enter actual receipts
steps: Enter known Giving/income, Lodging, and Travel received amounts.
The draft total shows the entered values and completion state.
Save draft while prerequisites remain unresolved. Enter all three amounts and confirm they are final before finalizing.

title: Read a finalized financial report
steps: Open Financials on the completed event to see its final received amounts.
The report contributes to the organization's finalized financial history.
Use the correction control when an amount needs to change; the original closer and close date are retained.
note: This completed report contains fictional amounts.

title: Edit role and digest preferences
steps: After confirming administrator access, open the user editor.
Change username or role and review the daily digest time and days.
Save the changes. Recheck the intended role before granting administrator access.

title: Use the daily agenda on a phone
steps: On a narrow screen, Calendar presents a daily agenda.
Use the day arrows or Today to change dates and the content selector to focus the list.
Open an event, task, or contact birthday to continue with that record.

title: Verify a new recovery email
steps: Open Change Recovery Email and enter the new email, current password, and a fresh authenticator code when required.
Select Verify New Email Address, then follow the verification message at the new address.
Your old address stays active until verification. The change signs out all sessions and pauses the digest.
Cancel a pending change or resend verification from My Profile if needed.

title: Sign in to MOED
steps: Enter the username and your private password.
Complete the authenticator or recovery-code challenge if your account uses 2FA.
If prompted to change a temporary password or enroll an authenticator, complete that step before continuing.
Use the account menu to sign out when finished.

title: Request password recovery
steps: Choose Forgot your password? on sign-in.
Enter the verified email address on the active account and request a reset link.
Follow the single-use link to choose a new password. Existing sessions are invalidated.
If no verified email or recovery factor is available, contact an administrator.
